title: Chapter 747
paragraphs: Chapter 747
Episode 184. Beyond Fate (19)
Whooong...!
Incredibly, the sea of lightning that had been covering the ground disappeared at once. Only the protective lightning surrounding Jin remained on the ground where he had just fallen.
'... As expected, the synchronization rate was too high. That was the problem.'
Jin got up and examined his body.
His body felt heavy, as if a mountain was pressing on his shoulder.
Since he had used a power several times stronger than what he possessed in a short period of time, there was bound to be backlash.
'I'm not too injured to fight. Plus, the monster's damage is much greater than mine.'
As he raised his head, he saw Lam's form, brutally shattered beyond recognition.
In front of him was the monster's body.
The broken, bent horn, and the melting flesh depicted the struggle to cut the red line.
The body disappeared completely before Jin could do anything else, scattering somewhere.
"What happened?"
"Is... is it over?"
"The mental attack through chaos has stopped."
Trembling voices echoed from the allied formations.
Everyone was desperately hoping that this terrifying fight was finally over.
However, Orugal narrowed his eyes and shook his head.
He and Jin were the first to notice that the spirits were condensing again.
[It seems the monster has undergone a sort of awakening.]
"Awakening?"
At Veradin's question, Orugal nodded.

[Yes. The blessing of growth through overcoming the boundary of life and death is not exclusive to mortals. If my guess is correct, the monster has just attained a higher divinity. As a price for resisting the Divine Union of the Underworld race while gambling...]
"…So you're saying it's stronger than before?"

[In an absolute sense, yes. Given enough time to recover, the monster is definitely stronger. But right now, the spirits that the Divine Union has annihilated are too vast. I can guess why the Divine Union suddenly stopped, but if we had about 3 more minutes, the monster would not have awakened.]
"3 minutes, that's unfortunate."
Veradin was overwhelmed by regret and an immense sense of emptiness.
Even when the greatest forces of humanity risked their lives together, they could not achieve what the Divine Union almost did in less than 30 minutes.
Veradin began to command again. While Ban was pushing the monster, fortunately, the fleet had not suffered much damage.
His comrades on the ground were running towards Jin.
"Jin!"
"Jin, are you okay?"
"Youngest!"
[12th class!]
Jin, about to turn to them, suddenly felt a chill on his back and quickly raised his sword.
Swoosh-!
A streak of dark sword energy grazed Jin's cheek.
Following that, hundreds of such energies were swooping down towards Jin and his comrades.
It was the monster's sword energy.
His comrades stepped forward to spread their swords, but Jin had already spread a shield to prevent them from doing so.
"The energy is denser. Everyone retreat as you will be exposed."
[Youngest, this time you really pushed this creature to the brink of extinction.]
The monster's gloomy voice came once more.
As if the melted flesh was just an illusion, the monster was floating in the air looking completely unscathed.
[I was really in danger... But once again, fate did not allow something else to intervene between you and me. The deity was definitely stronger than me, but in the end, it couldn't finish it off.]
Kwaaaaa!
The fleet poured fire towards the monster.
Although many cannons seemed to hit directly, the explosion only obscured the monster for a moment, then got absorbed and disappeared in the spread of black curtain.
The monster looked down at Jin and smiled slyly.
[Now, I think I understand your feelings a bit more. So this is what it feels like when destiny helps me.]
"At this point, you should have stopped spouting such nonsense, isn't it tiring?"
[Expect it. But as the situation has changed, so should the stage.]
As soon as the monster finished speaking.
Jin and the allies began to feel vibrations under their feet.
The ground was shaking as if it was about to collapse.
Thud, creak...
The result of the vibration was not the collapse of the ground.
Like the roots of a large tree being pulled out, the ground began to surge upward in one piece.
The surging ground floated up rapidly towards the fragments of Lam stuck in the air like dots.
"Evade the fragments of Lam while scattering the fleet. We can't hit them!"
The fleet dispersed, raising its altitude to match the speed of the rising ground, and the ground troops ran like crazy to avoid the fragments of Lam.
It took less than 10 seconds for the ground and Lam's fragments to merge.
There were no casualties on the ground during that process, but about twenty vessels and a dozen dragons were crushed by hitting the fragments.
10 miles.
The area of the rising ground matched exactly with the battlefield of Lam.
The ground moved like flowing water, filling in the shattered cracks of Lam.
Lam was being repaired. The allies, once again in shock, had to find the cracks and avoid them or spread them wider to ascend to the upper part of Lam.
Jin swung his spirit sword tirelessly. His core, like an overworked power source, could not properly form spirit energy.
One by one, the allies took their places on the upper part of Lam.
Whenever a part of Lam burst like a tumor, allied ships, dragons, or soldiers were seen coming up.
In other words, the allies ascended with the ground to the sky above Lam.
The first thing they saw was the darkly dyed sky and clouds.
The monster stood in the middle, waiting for Jin's arrival.
The form of Lam, repaired by merging with the ground, was not stable as before.
It was full of stains and cracks like clothes made of rags, and the main cannon seemed to be nonfunctional.
However, the fact that this terrifying ship, nearly 10 miles in length, had regained its form was enough to unsettle the temporary alliance.
As Orgal said, given enough time, Lam would also return to a more complete form than before.
The chance was still now, the last one.
If the monster was not extinguished today, the next to disappear would surely be the temporary alliance and humanity.
[What will you do now? Youngest. You probably want to run away and wait for a chance to summon the deity again... but I don't want to allow that.]
Again, a storm of spirit energy was swirling around the edge of Lam.
It was impossible for the fleet to penetrate through, and even Orgal's dimensional gate wasn't working properly.
"I've never thought about running away. Because I've come to settle things today....."
Release of spiritual energy.
From Jin, the spirit energy spread out like a spider web.
In an instant, the spirit energy cast a deep shadow over the entire area where Jin and the monster stood.
At the same time, the fleet's observing magicians were confirming that forces of chaos were pouring out from the spirit energy curtain that stood like a wall around Lam.
"Northern wall, approximately ten thousand troops confirmed! Comprised of chaos dragons, black ships, and knights!"
"Thunderstorm!?"
"It's one of the old top ten knights, Paddler Lundkendel! Behind him, there's a large army including black knights...!"
[Right, I was wondering why I couldn't see you. It's finally your turn to go to hell, Paddler!]
"The knight who just attacked the 2nd fleet is definitely a superhuman, the remaining grandmaster!?"
From the east, west, south, and north, new forces of chaos were pouring in.
It was Cheongnyeong King Paddler Lundkendel and the remaining four Grandmasters.
Jin couldn't hear the voices of his allies. Not only was the distance too far, but the spiritual and spirit energies mixed between Jin and the monster were blocking the sound.
However, Jin sensed through his intuition that new forces had emerged.
"You had more hidden forces, monster."
[I find it extremely satisfying to have to use all the cards I have while dealing with you. Plus, I even had to take a risk to gain a higher divine status... Ugh!]
The grotesque deity that was in the middle of speaking suddenly doubled over and clamped its mouth shut. A chunk of blackness spilled out from between its fingers. Its pupils dilated.

"Satisfied? It's troublesome when you're so full of energy after receiving the damage of the Twin Deities. It seems like you didn't really know your own condition because you were so intoxicated by your rapid growth."
After the fusion with the Twin Deities, Jin had inherited all the memories accumulated during his half of the battle with the grotesque deity.
The 'End' is a sword that tears even the opponent's soul.
Even if the grotesque deity had successfully awakened, there were still deep wounds left on its body and soul by 'The End'. Invisible sparks of energy were writhing inside it.
"And just as you have remaining reinforcements, so do we."
Jin spread his energy release even deeper.
- Tell Jin to maximize his energy release when it's most needed. He will appear immediately.
This was the message Misha had sent to Jin through Sirius and Mot before the battle began.
[Grrraaahhh!]
The grotesque deity let out a roar and rushed at Jin.
Jin, without avoiding the incoming frenzy, wore a smirk.
Before the frenzy could touch him.
In front of Jin, a shadow formed as his energy condensed.
Long, rugged hair down to his waist, sharp eyes, and a low voice that filled the room.
"It's been a while, kid."
It was Murakan in human form.
As soon as he appeared, he showed great strength by stopping the grotesque deity's blade with his bare hands.
"Why does it always feel like we say the same things in these situations?"
"It sounds good, doesn’t it?"
"I guess so."
[Murakan……!]
The grotesque deity glared at Jin and Murakan with a face distorted by rage.
[That's right, I anticipated your appearance. Guardian deity of the ancient times, you were busy running away last time. Will you fight properly today?]
To that, Murakan wanted to respond impressively with a chuckle, but he could only let out a sound that was a bit embarrassing.
"Ouch!"
This was because the soul energy spreading from the blade of frenzy was penetrating his hand.
Like a person touched by fire, Murakan took a startled step back. Even the grotesque deity was stunned for a moment. Jin instinctively put a hand to his forehead.
"Hmm, I momentarily forgot that the grotesque deity is the source of the soul infection. Kid, no one saw me just now, did they?"
Jin shrugged, but seeing Murakan fooling around as soon as he arrived, he felt a sense of relief inside.
This was because Murakan's lack of seriousness meant that the enemy wasn't threatening enough to be unmanageable.
